status: Selected bounded continuation-development phase, declared after the finite termination proof and before any fifth-block query or implementation. No existing frozen source may change while selected-parity comparative timing runs. Independent implementation and driver preflight are required before this phase executes.
hypothesis: The fresh fourth-sweep receiver still ends four frames after positive net cancellation-count growth. Such a change reduces the fitted outside count and changes the next fixed queue, residual and scalar query model. Continuing this same discovery/refit calculation while its cancellation count grows may recover further complete messages at a finite, state-dependent allowance, without selecting another arbitrary sweep cap.

operation.reference: The independently verified native-only repetition plus query memoization, terminal support completion and conditional fourth-sweep DEC-35 profile. Rollback512 and continuation128 retain original PolarCode providers. This does not combine the separately tested all-stage acceleration profile.
operation.first_four: Preserve the original first three sweeps, then the existing fourth trigger based on actual count moves anywhere in sweep three. Preserve every initial refit, fixed block queue, within-block residual update, code call, full-ID conversion, bank update, refit and exact-byte cache. Do not restart a continuation or recreate its bank/cache between blocks.
operation.later_trigger: After block four or any later completed block, allow the next block only if the endpoint cancellation-count total is strictly larger than the count at the start of that block. Existing incomplete-refit and no-new-ID stops take priority. Temporary growth, count-neutral swaps, drops alone, new IDs without count growth, terminal support completion and truth do not trigger another block.
operation.known_K_edge: A growing block ending at K permits one final block under this exact rule; it will terminate if it does not grow. Do not silently replace this by a stop-at-K policy.
operation.discovery_and_fit: Every block retains the fixed top min(P,K+5) absolute-residual pattern queue formed at its start. Each query uses the latest raw residual and original outside-count variance; original SCL128 generates legal complete payloads, associated with their queried pattern. Every found full ID enters the bank, and every new-ID update invokes the unchanged unrestricted CountBank refit with max_moves=2000. No supplied pattern, companion, true prefix or restricted discovery bank.
operation.decision: Apply the unchanged support-completion decision once after continuation terminates. Preserve cancellation multiplicities and count-PUPE evaluation. An extra false copy can alter cancellation and later decisions, so no pointwise accuracy dominance over the four-sweep receiver is claimed.

exact_bound_and_cost.bound: Let c4 be the terminal count of a completed growing fourth block. At most K-c4+1 additional blocks may start, including the last non-growing or incomplete block. The whole continuation has at most K-c4+5 <= K-c3+4 <= K+4 blocks. At K100 and Q105 the universal bound is104 blocks and10920 logical queries; actual SCL calls are no more than logical queries.
exact_bound_and_cost.why_new_work_is_justified: The verified fresh128 fourth block adds53 retained true IDs on four frames, and each of those blocks has positive net cancellation-count growth. Its .698% complete-cost overhead demonstrates an actual useful continuation mechanism at the previous cap. The new count potential gives a termination rule for testing whether that capability persists; it does not assume another gain.
exact_bound_and_cost.charged: Every all-pattern queue construction, residual/variance/LLR calculation, byte-cache lookup, actual SCL call, full-message association, bank construction/update, physical refit and terminal completion is charged. Native and rollback costs are included in any later complete receiver experiment. A finite K-based bound alone is not an affordable worst-case memory or runtime guarantee: bank growth and refits remain measured.
exact_bound_and_cost.resource_policy: There is no new numerical beam, sweep or query budget to tune in this phase. The existing2000-move cap remains and any incomplete fit fails the completeness gate. The count theorem is asserted at runtime. Measured cost and peak memory must be reported even for failure; no historical initialization time is presented as a newly measured receiver runtime.

retained_and_discarded.retained: Original balanced encoder and actual CRC/polar code, physical y and Gaussian noise variance, known K, IID full-message source, repeated patterns/messages, complete-message identity, multiplicity-aware fitting and count-PUPE. Original scalar-channel and outside-Gaussian approximations remain exactly those of the reference.
retained_and_discarded.changed: Only the continuation stopping/allocation policy after the verified fourth block changes. It supplies new conditioned calculations from the same observation, not new channel measurements or a new likelihood.
retained_and_discarded.discarded: The growth predicate declines further work after potentially useful equal-count or net-negative corrections. Conversely it can continue after accepting false copies. CountBank objective values across changing banks are not used as a common potential; bounded integer cancellation count alone proves termination.
retained_and_discarded.assumptions: The capability hypothesis is that repeated net-positive fitted count changes often remove enough true interference to expose new ordinary-query candidates. It is falsified by lack of repeated recovery, harmful trajectories or inability to complete at the proved allowance; algebra alone does not establish it.

development_panel.seeds: All128 frame-zero seeds7101 through7228 from progress_continuation/confirmation/main, not a subset of the four improved frames.
development_panel.initialization: Use the bound original physical/source realization and saved native/rollback initial action and complete base bank from that panel. Re-run both continuations and decisions from the same immutable initial inputs, with fresh private banks/caches. No final four-sweep candidate or cancellation state is supplied to either starting bank.
arms: Identical first-four policy with strict endpoint count-growth continuation
development_panel.order: Alternate the two complete continuation-arm orders by seed. Construct geometry once per frame, separately report it, and preserve inputs between arms. Reconcile the reference and the candidate's original prefix against the archived fourth-sweep result.
development_panel.timing_scope: New continuation plus support-completion times are paired and measured. Geometry/source reconstruction and historical native/rollback initialization are reported separately. This reused-context development panel is not fresh population evidence or a newly measured complete receiver runtime.

frozen_development_gates.cost_scope: Report measured additional queries, complete continuation cost, peak memory and every frame's cost and false-copy change. There is no retrospective cost threshold that can be tuned to accept an outcome. Passing capability licenses review of actual cost and a separately frozen fresh complete receiver; it is not performance-cost dominance.

required_preflight: The independent finite count-growth proof and fixed physical counterexamples have already passed. Bind their declaration, source and output before implementation.

Verify the new optional implementation preserves the existing default and conditional-fourth paths exactly, including intermediate refit metadata, caches, original pattern queues and caller inputs. Existing scientific sources and hashes remain archived for prior experiments.

Use tiny fixed fixtures with repeated messages, count-neutral swaps, drops, temporary increases, growth to K, no-new-ID and incomplete-refit stops. Verify terminal completion never feeds cancellation or the predicate, and no hidden refit/reinitialization occurs between blocks.

Before any fifth-block query, freeze the driver, source snapshots, all128 physical/source hashes and historical input records, arm order, cost accounting, count metrics and literal gate calculations. Independently audit outcomes before any fresh receiver phase.
advancement_and_stop: A failed development gate stops this strict-count-growth continuation policy without a new threshold, alternating schedule or count-neutral retry. A pass permits a separately declared fresh complete comparison against the current verified four-sweep DEC-35 profile, with full native/rollback/discovery/refit/readout cost and no shared accepted lists or historical timing credit. Neither outcome closes all continuation rules or completes the overarching research goal.
implementation_sequence: During the selected-parity main, prepare only declarations/read review and new independent source drafts. Do not edit its35 frozen dependencies. Preserve the previous feedback source before a later narrowly scoped optional extension, then verify unchanged original profiles and current source bindings before running this phase.
